title: Stonebridge Insights — LLM contract & integration working notes
content:
Call 2025-01-14 — initial discovery (notes to self)
Participants: Maya T. (me), Ravi P. (SE), Sofia G. (Stonebridge PM), Mark H. (Stonebridge infra lead)

High-level ask: Stonebridge wants to embed a summarization + custom QA assistant into their internal analytics portal. Primary constraints: PHI-adjacent logs (pseudonymized), strict audit requirements, single-region EU hosting, and 99.9% availability for interactive queries (p95 latency target ~200ms for short queries).

Immediate contract items mentioned on call:
- Private deployment preferred (VPC) + customer-managed KMS.
- Minimum reserved capacity for steady-state (expected 6k qps tokens/day across short queries) + burst for quarter-end (x3).
- Audit logs retention 7y, tamper-evident logging desired.
- Support SLA (4h P1 response, 24/7 on-call for production incidents).

Technical capture / rough requirements:
- Usecases: real-time summarization (max input ~3k tokens), contextual QA (chat-like with 10–20 turn conversation, need KV cache across short sessions).
- Model constraints: prefers an open Llama-derivative (we discussed 13B/30B variants) but will accept a Redwood-curated variant if we can certify privacy controls.
- Latency SLO: interactive queries avg <200ms p50, <500ms p95. Backend budget: aiming for equivalent cost < $0.0006 / token on avg (ballpark).
- Data residency: EU-only. Private control plane (customer-managed) vs Redwood-hosted control plane? They strongly prefer private control plane but are open to hybrid if we can show audit & key ownership flows.

Gotchas / red flags we flagged to them:
- Long audit-retention + tamper-evident logs implies storage + egress cost; need to scope how logs are exported and who owns them.
- 7y retention may conflict with certain retention policies for model telemetry — we need an opt-out pipeline for telemetry that contains PII.
- Burst capacity x3 means we should propose a guaranteed Dedicated pool with pre-warmed instances or quick-scaling policy; cold start for quantized models can be non-trivial.
- KV cache semantics for multi-turn QA: must guarantee session isolation and ability to evict/purge on demand to meet privacy requests.

Initial architecture suggestions (sketch):
- Private deployment (VPC) in eu-west-1 region, customer-managed KMS (HSM if they insist).
- Dedicated Redwood GPU pool behind a Smart Routing policy: route short low-cost queries to quantized 13B variant, fall back to 30B non-quantized for longer/higher-quality.
- Enable prefix/KV caching with per-session encryption keys (derive from KMS) so logs/kv blobs are encrypted at rest with customer keys.
- Audit logging: write to s3-like bucket in their account + ship digest+signature to Redwood control plane for tamper evidence (we need engineering confirm on signature flow).

Back-of-envelope capacity + cost notes (rough) — to refine with infra team:
- Assumptions: avg 50 tokens per interactive query; 6k queries/day -> 300k tokens/day steady. Burst x3 = 900k tokens/day peak.
- Rough cost if hosted: at $0.0006 / token -> $180 / day steady, $540 / day burst (obviously we will provide dedicated pricing).
- GPU sizing: for quantized 13B we can push high throughput per GPU (need runbook from serving-runtime team for real numbers).

Open questions for Stonebridge (to send before follow-up):
1) Data classification: confirm which fields are considered PHI vs pseudonymized. Are there any fields that cannot leave their VPC even as encrypted blobs?
2) KMS requirement: customer KMS in their account or can Redwood manage a key in an HSM with split control?
3) Audit ingestion: where do they want the primary audit copy stored (their S3 or Redwood)?
4) Expected concurrency pattern (burst window length, typical qps).
5) Which model quality threshold (ROUGE / human eval) do they need for summaries? Any existing evals to share?

Action items / next steps (tentative owners & dates):
- Maya: send this capture + clarify open Qs to Sofia by 2025-01-17.
- Ravi: run a quick throughput/latency estimate with serving-runtime for 13B quantized in eu-west-1 — ETA 2025-01-22. Link results to JIRA-SB-1123.
- Engineering (Ravi + infra): prototype KMS key-wrap flow and put short note in GH PR referenced above — ETA 2025-01-29.
- SE/Price (Ava): draft initial dedicated capacity pricing + commitment tiers for 12/24/36 month contracts — first pass by 2025-01-24.
- Maya: schedule follow-up with Stonebridge for 2025-01-28 to review pricing + architecture.

Random notes / To myself (informal) — do not forget:
- Check compliance pack options in security-and-compliance product docs (we need to confirm 7y retention is okay).
- If they push on private control plane but want Redwood telemetry, present hybrid: telemetry sanitized upstream + audit digests only.
- Consider proposing Redwood Optimize eval run (small eval harness) to show cost/quality tradeoffs across 13B quantized vs 30B non-quantized.

Meeting snippets (quick quotes):
- Mark H: "we can't have any keys leaving our tenancy" -> pushes HSM requirement
- Sofia: "if you can show predictable latency during peak month-end reports, we'll sign" -> emphasizes burst SLA

Draft email bullets for follow-up (copy/paste friendly):
- Thanks for the call — capture of top-level asks and next steps (attached a short architecture sketch).
- We will: 1) validate latency/throughput numbers for 13B quantized in eu-west-1, 2) prototype KMS wrapping flow, 3) draft Dedicated capacity pricing.
- Please confirm: PHI scope, KMS ownership preference, primary audit store location, and expected concurrency pattern.

End of notes.

-- Maya
